entities.summary: Johan Olaf Brochmann Nordhagen was a Norwegian educator, architect, engineer and artist. He is most commonly associated with his restoration designs for Nidaros Cathedral in Trondheim, Norway. Olaf Nordhagen was a writers & intellectuals from Christiania (1883-03-16, Christiania–1925-11-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
